description: Enforcement-doctrine gate 4 (check half, commit): on `git commit`, verify the mandatory skills (delegate-work-to-subagents, visual-proof-cycle; override via SKILLS_READ_MANDATORY) were Skill-tool-invoked this session. Warns first, then BLOCKS a repeat. Applies to orchestrator AND subagents. Honest escape hatch: SKIP_SKILLS_READ_GATE=1 + SKIP_SKILLS_READ_GATE_REASON='why', or an inline `# skills-read-ok: why`. on_error=open.
